description: This file defines the WidgetPreviewActivity class for Android, which allows users to select, configure, display, snapshot, and share a widget preview within the app. It manages widget lifecycle, rendering a widget's preview image, saving it, and initiating email sharing.

classes.name: WidgetPreviewActivity
classes.description: An Activity for selecting, configuring, previewing, and exporting an Android app widget, with functionality to save a bitmap screenshot and share via email.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up widget host, and handles widget selection or restoration.

methods.name: onRetainNonConfigurationInstance
methods.description: Retains widget info across configuration changes.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles widget selection result, starts configuration if needed.

methods.name: setAppWidget
methods.description: Sets up the widget view after selection.

methods.name: finishSetAppWidget
methods.description: Completes widget setup, creates preview view, and adjusts dimensions.

methods.name: getLauncherCellDimensions
methods.description: Calculates widget preview dimensions based on grid cell sizes.

methods.name: buildFile
methods.description: Constructs a file path for saving the widget preview PNG, based on orientation and widget name.

methods.name: getPreviewBitmap
methods.description: Generates a bitmap snapshot of the widget preview.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves the bitmap as a PNG file to external storage.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Handles back navigation, either popping back stack or restarting widget selection.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles snapshot and email sharing button clicks.
